data.name: El Dorado
data.headline: Overnight stay • Up to 4 guests
data.description:
##About
Indulge in the perfect blend of comfort and adventure at El Dorado. Our glamping bell tent accommodates 4 guests, offering a queen bed and two twin pull-outs with premium linen. Embrace the outdoor lifestyle with amenities like an outdoor shower, hammocks, a picnic table, and a propane grill. Gather around the firepit for memorable evenings, all while enjoying the scenic view of horses in the pasture.

Please note that our shared portable toilets are just a short walk from all sites, ensuring a convenient and nature-friendly experience. Immerse yourself in the beauty of the outdoors without sacrificing modern comforts. Book your stay now for a unique glamping getaway!

$120 per night
